Challenge: Read the Scout Promise aloud to one teammate (tap "Show extra info"; only the reader may look), repeating it as many times as you both feel is needed for them to memorise it. They must then tell it to the other teammate, again repeating it as many times as needed. The second teammate then repeats it back to the reader. They get one attempt only and no mistakes are allowed; any mistake is a fail. Fastest wins.
Pass Mark: Promise repeated back with no mistakes
Info:
The Scout Promise:

I promise that I will do my best
to uphold our Scout values, to do my duty to The King,
to help other people
and to keep the Cub Scout Law.
Challenge (2p): Read the Scout Promise aloud to your teammate (tap "Show extra info"; only the reader may look), repeating it as many times as you both feel is needed for them to memorise it. They then repeat it back to you. They get one attempt only and no mistakes are allowed; any mistake is a fail. Fastest wins.

Challenge: One teammate is the phone holder: they operate the app and do not count. The other two stand facing away from each other and from the phone holder, in complete silence, with no communication of any kind allowed. The phone holder presses "Start Challenge Attempt" to reveal this challenge, then presses "Start the Timer" once everyone is ready; from that moment the two counters count 75 seconds in their heads. The next thing anyone may say is "Time", called by either counter; the first to say it stops the attempt for the whole team, and the phone holder presses the finish button immediately. Nobody sees a running clock, and the main game timer is hidden too; that is deliberate. Land within 5 seconds of 1:15 to pass; the time closest to 1:15 wins a steal.
Challenge (2p): One teammate is the phone holder: they operate the app and do not count. The other teammate stands facing away from them in complete silence, with no communication of any kind allowed. The phone holder presses "Start Challenge Attempt" to reveal this challenge, then presses "Start the Timer" once you are both ready; from that moment the counter counts 75 seconds in their head. The next thing anyone may say is "Time", called by the counter, and the phone holder presses the finish button immediately. Nobody sees a running clock, and the main game timer is hidden too; that is deliberate. Land within 5 seconds of 1:15 to pass; the time closest to 1:15 wins a steal.

Challenge: One teammate taps "Show extra info" and reads the secret handshake; only they may look at it. They must teach it to the other two teammates without showing them the screen. Those two then perform the handshake together while the reader checks it, with nobody looking at the screen once they begin. They get one attempt only and no mistakes are allowed; any mistake is a fail. Fastest wins.
Info:
The secret handshake:

1. Right hand high five, above your heads.
2. Left hand low five, below your knees.
3. Two fist bumps with your right fists, then two with your left fists.
4. Link right elbows and turn one full circle together.
5. Both clap your own hands twice.
6. Both finish with a Scout salute.
Challenge (2p): One teammate taps "Show extra info" and reads the secret handshake; only they may look at it. They must teach it to their partner without showing them the screen. The two of you then perform the handshake together, with nobody looking at the screen once you begin. Your partner gets one attempt only and no mistakes are allowed; any mistake is a fail. Fastest wins.

Challenge: Find an image of an extinct animal. It cannot be on a screen or electronic device, and not on anything owned by any player. Fastest wins.

Make an A4 sized target out of any materials you can find, then measure out five metres from it as accurately as you can. Standing behind that line, throw stones (each over 2cm across) at the target. Every stone that lands on the target scores one point, and once a stone has hit the target it cannot be thrown again. You have 5 minutes. Most points wins.
Guess the distance from the edge of the arena stage to the till of the scout shop, in metres (you can include the centimetres, e.g. "38.25"). No electronic device help allowed. Closest guess wins.

Find as many different leaves as possible. Each leaf must come from a tree or bush, and must clearly be a different species to any leaf you have already gathered. Grass, ferns and other non woody plants do not count. Most leaves wins.

Act out the 5 animals hidden under "Show extra info" — only the actor may look! No sounds or talking allowed except confirming a correct guess, and your team must say the EXACT name of each animal. Any talking or unauthorised communication is a fail. Fastest wins.
Info:
Act these out, in order:

1. Elephant
2. Butterfly
3. Vulture
4. Spider
5. Chimpanzee

Challenge: Decide which teammate will be the signaller; they hold the phone. Another teammate stands at least 10 metres away as the caller. The app shows one random letter at a time: the signaller signals it in semaphore and the caller must say it out loud correctly. Press "Correct, Next Letter" to bank it and move on, or end the challenge at any point to lock in your score. You will not be told how many you have banked or how many letters are left; keeping count is up to you. If the caller gets one wrong you must record it as a fail, and the whole challenge is failed, so stop while you are ahead. Your score is the number of letters you banked. Most letters wins.
Find five insects (they must be insects); no more than three may be the same type, so five ants only counts as three. Fastest wins.
Pass Mark: All five insects found (max 3 of one type)

Challenge: Find a spiderweb. Fastest wins.
Find three twigs or sticks (don't remove from living plants) that are exactly the same length and at least 5cm long. You cannot snap them to change their length. Fastest wins.
Pass Mark: Three matching twigs or sticks, at least 5cm

Challenge: What year did the Scout Association originally purchase the land for Bushy Wood Activity Centre? No research allowed — closest guess wins.

Balance as many objects as you can (each larger than a grape and smaller than a 500ml water bottle) on top of each other in a single stack. The stack must stand unsupported for 10 seconds to count. Enter the number of objects you managed to balance. Most objects wins.
Pass Mark: At least 2 objects balanced for 10 seconds

Challenge: Find twigs and sticks (don't remove from living plants) that, laid down end to end in a line, add up to the height of your shortest team member. They must all be laid out at the same time, so gather as many as you need. Fastest wins.
Pass Mark: Line of twigs and sticks matches their height

Challenge: One teammate is the phone holder: they operate the app and do not plank. The other two get into a proper plank: body straight from head to heels, weight on forearms (elbows under shoulders) and toes, hips level (not sagging or raised), core engaged. Once they are both set and holding it, the phone holder presses "Start the Timer"; setup time does not count towards your score. The moment the first person stops or their form breaks, the phone holder hits the finish button and the elapsed time is your result. LONGEST time wins.
Pass Mark: Both planking teammates hold a proper plank
Challenge (2p): One teammate is the phone holder: they operate the app and do not plank. The other gets into a proper plank: body straight from head to heels, weight on forearms (elbows under shoulders) and toes, hips level (not sagging or raised), core engaged. Once they are set and holding it, the phone holder presses "Start the Timer"; setup time does not count towards your score. The moment they stop or their form breaks, the phone holder hits the finish button and the elapsed time is your result. LONGEST time wins.
Pass Mark (2p): The planking teammate holds a proper plank

Challenge: Stick together as a team and find Joe. You must fist bump him to confirm you found him; spotting him from a distance does not count. Then return here to this zone before completing the challenge. Fastest wins.
Pass Mark: Joe fist bumped and team returned

Challenge: One teammate makes pictures of animals on the ground from natural objects; another teammate must name each one. The namer must turn around and not watch while a picture is being made, and only turns back once it is finished. They get one guess per animal: if they are wrong you simply move on to the next animal and nothing is failed. You can attempt any animals you like and stop whenever you want. Your score is the number of animals correctly named. Most animals wins.

Choose a teammate: they go away where they can't see or hear you (they may research while away). The rest create a scout tracking sign; searching online for a real design to copy is allowed. The solo teammate returns and has ONE guess at what it means. A wrong guess is a fail. Fastest wins.
Pass Mark: Sign guessed on the first try

Challenge: One teammate is the phone holder: they operate the app and do not balance. The other two each balance a natural object larger than a lime (stone, stick, pinecone…) on top of their head. Once they are both balanced and ready, the phone holder presses "Start the Timer"; setup time does not count towards your score. The moment the first person's object falls, the phone holder hits the finish button and the elapsed time is your result. LONGEST time wins.
Pass Mark: Both balancing teammates balance an object
Challenge (2p): One teammate is the phone holder: they operate the app and do not balance. The other balances a natural object larger than a lime (stone, stick, pinecone…) on top of their head. Once they are balanced and ready, the phone holder presses "Start the Timer"; setup time does not count towards your score. The moment the object falls, the phone holder hits the finish button and the elapsed time is your result. LONGEST time wins.
Pass Mark (2p): The balancing teammate balances an object

Challenge: How big is the Bushy Wood site in acres? As a rough guide, a football pitch is about 1.7 acres. No research allowed; closest guess wins.
